format: C header file (lua C API bindings)
description: This file defines C functions that serve as Lua bindings for IO operations, including printing various types, loading JSON data, and reading text files in different formats.

methods.name: print
methods.description: A generic printing utility that can handle any Lua type and output it to stdout.

methods.name: loadJSON
methods.description: Loads and parses JSON data from a file into Lua.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file as a string.

methods.name: loadStrings
methods.description: Reads a file and returns its contents as an array of lines.
